data.exact_reserve_text: During 2015 the estimated ultimate loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2014 and prior years of account was increased. These increases are set out in the table below together with their effect on ultimate claims reserves.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account leading to a substantial strengthening of reserves for prior years.

prior_year_events.event_name: Personal Accident & Sickness prior year reserve increase
prior_year_events.impact_description: Estimated ultimate loss ratio increased leading to an increase in ultimate claims reserves for Personal Accident & Sickness.

prior_year_events.event_name: Special Lines prior year reserve increase
prior_year_events.impact_description: Estimated ultimate loss ratio increased leading to an increase in ultimate claims reserves for Special Lines.

data.standardized_narrative: In 2015 the syndicate recorded a gross strengthening of prior year reserves of GBP 35.757m, driven predominantly by adverse development in the US Liability (Casualty) account (GBP 30.486m) with smaller increases in Personal Accident & Sickness (GBP 3.638m) and Special Lines (GBP 1.633m). Management conducted a detailed review in 2015 which resulted in substantial reserve strengthening for the 2013 and earlier years; the movement was attributed to worse-than-expected claims experience in volatile liability exposures and recalibration of IBNR.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration arose on the 2013 and prior years of account and emanates primarily from the Liability account
worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account
reserves strengthened substantially for the 2013 and prior years of account
During 2015 the estimated ultimate loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2014 and prior years of account was increased.
